title: Register Request
description: POST /api/v1/auth/register body. NOTE: the server REJECTS an unknown key with a 400 rather than ignoring it. That is deliberately NOT yet encoded as additionalProperties:false, because closing the set is a breaking change for any consumer validating against this schema, and because the currently deployed producer still accepts two retired credential fields this document does not declare. Closing it is scheduled for the next major, once the producer it describes is live. Do not read additionalProperties:true as permission to send extra keys -- they are refused at runtime.

role.description: Advisory-only. Backend always assigns the server-side default role (AUTH-002). Clients should omit this field; the contract may add an enum constraint in a future minor version.

access_code.description: Optional. The administrator-issued cohort code. Distinct from registration_code: reusable within its cohort and not bound to one address. Mutually exclusive with the other two credential fields.

invite_token.description: Optional. Single-use invitation token. Mutually exclusive with the other two credential fields.

registration_code.description: Optional. The single-use, address-bound code delivered by e-mail to a self-serve registrant. Presented to the reader as their "access code"; registration_code is the wire name and the two deliberately differ, because access_code is a different credential resolved against a different store. Mutually exclusive with the other two credential fields.
